name: Muddy Journal Pages
summary: Muddy Journal Pages were recovered from a murder scene in Duskwood years ago. Weathered and stained with soil, they remain with Tavernkeep Smitts, who kept them without proof of authorship as evidence in an unresolved local investigation.

sections.title: The Evidence of the Massacre
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts found the pages in the mire after visiting nobles were slaughtered in Duskwood. He had gone to the scene with Haggard, the investigator. The town had no handwriting samples or confirmed records to connect the writing to a suspect, so Smitts kept the pages quietly in Darkshire's tavern. He waited for an investigator to gather scattered records from across the southern kingdoms and match the script to the recluse living deep in the woods.

faq.q: Where were the muddy journal pages found?
aliases: where did smitts find the pages
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts and Haggard found the pages at the scene where visiting nobles were slaughtered in the woods of Duskwood several years ago.

faq.q: Why couldn't Smitts use the pages when he first found them?
aliases: why didn't smitts turn them in
faq.answer: The local investigators had no writing samples to compare with the pages, so they could not connect the handwriting to a suspect.

faq.q: Who needs to see these pages?
aliases: who do i give the muddy pages to
faq.answer: The pages must be brought to Commander Althea Ebonlocke, leader of the Night Watch in Darkshire, to report the investigation into the nobles' slaughter.

faq.q: What crime do these pages connect to?
faq.answer: The pages connect to the slaughter of visiting nobles in the woods of Duskwood several years ago, a crime Darkshire could not solve at the time.

angles.text: For the Alliance, solving the slaughter of Stormwind nobles brings overdue closure to a lingering case in Duskwood's embattled settlements.
As a Rogue, piecing together forgotten handwriting samples and weathered diary scraps shows the methodical forensic work needed before striking down a hidden killer.
